newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Akros financial holding to increase capital.
newsitem.headline: Italy Akros financial holding to increase capital.

text.p: Shareholders in Italian financial holding Akros Finanziaria approved an 85.3 billion capital increase to take place by December.

Akros shareholders had opted for a capital increase in July rather than create a joint venture between the holding's brokerage house Akros Sim and financial services group Sopaf which owns brokers Pasfin.

Shareholders voting for the capital increase at an extraordinary general meeting included the largest single shareholder Commercial Union Plc, which has 7.5 percent, and Coloniale of the Tanzi family, majority shareholders in the Parmalat food group, with some three percent. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
